verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a full API reference: a generated endpoint and schema reference, a canonical OpenAPI document with 174 paths, and a docs MCP server exposing the API reference. Its guides include working example requests, and a sandbox API lets developers run calls safely. However, no evidence shows an in-browser interactive reference with 'try it' runnable examples; the rendered docs are described only as JavaScript shells. missing for 10: documented interactive/try-it API explorer, runnable examples embedded in the reference itself, independent or hands-on corroboration of interactivity

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: a parseable OpenAPI document titled "Ramp Developer API" (v1) with 174 documented paths
A working POST /bills request that resolves every required UUID upfront.
